name: Wikidata Query Service (SPARQL)
description: A queryable knowledge graph of ~115 million items - people, places, works, species, buildings, elections - with a SPARQL endpoint that will answer questions no tabular source can, like 'every lighthouse in Europe with its construction year and coordinates'. Free, no key, and the results come back as JSON or CSV.

access.auth_note: no key; a descriptive User-Agent is required by the policy
access.size_hint: the full dump is ~140 GB compressed
access.rate_limit: 60 seconds of query time per query, and a concurrency cap per IP; expensive queries are killed rather than queued
access.etiquette: put LIMIT on exploratory queries; use the query service's own editor to test before scripting

recipes.title: Every lighthouse in a country with coordinates

gotchas.trap: A query with no LIMIT over a common property times out at 60 seconds and returns an HTML error page.
gotchas.fix: Add LIMIT, filter early, and prefer wdt: (truthy) over p:/ps: statement paths unless you need qualifiers.

gotchas.trap: Labels are not properties. Selecting ?itemLabel without the label service returns nothing.
